workflow_rationale: This is an investigation workflow because we need to: (1) Reproduce the new-project scenario by creating test projects, (2) Investigate what fails when ARCHITECTURE.md doesn't exist, (3) Fix the identified issues in MASTER_PROMPTs and pipeline, (4) Harden by validating across all supported stacks. The root cause is unknown until Phase 2 completes.

phases.name: Reproduce New-Project Scenarios
phases.description: Create minimal test projects for web and mobile stacks, attempt to run MASTER_PROMPTs without existing ARCHITECTURE.md, capture failures with detailed reproduction steps and logs

subtasks.notes: Create bare-minimum Next.js project structure without ARCHITECTURE.md or PROJECT_MAP.md to simulate new project state

subtasks.expected_output: Document with: (1) Full command used, (2) Complete output/logs, (3) Any errors or warnings, (4) Whether ARCHITECTURE.md was generated

verification.instructions: Review REPRODUCTION.md for complete output capture and error documentation

subtasks.notes: This exercises the untested new-project bootstrap path. Document everything - success or failure.

phases.name: Investigate Root Causes
phases.description: Analyze reproduction results, identify what fails when ARCHITECTURE.md doesn't exist, document root causes with evidence, propose fixes

subtasks.description: Analyze web MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap failures and identify root cause
subtasks.expected_output: ROOT_CAUSE.md with: (1) What fails, (2) Why it fails (evidence from reproduction), (3) Where in the code/prompts the issue exists, (4) Proposed fix approach

verification.instructions: Review ROOT_CAUSE_WEB.md for clear root cause identification with evidence and proposed fix

subtasks.notes: Identified 5 critical gaps: (1) missing trigger logic, (2) ambiguous file creation, (3) pipeline asymmetry with PROJECT_MAP.md, (4) no invocation documentation, (5) unvalidated path. Proposed 4 concrete fixes with exact locations.

subtasks.description: Analyze mobile MASTER_PROMPT bootstrap failures and identify root cause
subtasks.expected_output: ROOT_CAUSE.md with: (1) What fails, (2) Why it fails (evidence from reproduction), (3) Where in the code/prompts the issue exists, (4) Proposed fix approach

verification.instructions: Review ROOT_CAUSE_MOBILE.md for clear root cause identification with evidence and proposed fix

subtasks.notes: Identified 6 critical gaps (5 same as web + 1 mobile-specific): (1) missing trigger logic, (2) ambiguous file creation, (3) pipeline asymmetry with PROJECT_MAP.md, (4) variant selection gap (iOS/Android/KMP routing), (5) no invocation documentation, (6) unvalidated path. Analyzed iOS (Variant A) and Android (Variant B) reproductions - both generated excellent content (800+ and 1000+ lines) but NO files created. Proposed 4 concrete fixes with variant routing logic.

subtasks.description: Analyze pipeline Phase 1 behavior when ARCHITECTURE.md is missing
subtasks.expected_output: Document analyzing pipeline.md Phase 1 (Context Load) behavior when required files don't exist

verification.instructions: Review ROOT_CAUSE_PIPELINE.md for analysis of how pipeline handles missing context files

subtasks.notes: Pipeline Phase 1 expects ARCHITECTURE.md - document how it should handle new projects

subtasks.description: End-to-end verification: new project → MASTER_PROMPT → first feature

steps: Verify ARCHITECTURE.md exists and has proper structure

Verify pipeline can read ARCHITECTURE.md and complete feature

parallel_groups.reason: Phase 4 subtasks (web and mobile validation) can run in parallel - different file sets, same dependencies

parallelism.speedup_estimate: Sequential for investigation phases (1-3), parallel possible for validation (phase 4)

acceptance_criteria: Web MASTER_PROMPT successfully generates ARCHITECTURE.md for Next.js, React, and Vue projects
Mobile MASTER_PROMPT successfully generates ARCHITECTURE.md for iOS, Android, and KMP projects
Pipeline Phase 1 handles missing ARCHITECTURE.md gracefully
End-to-end flow (new project → MASTER_PROMPT → first feature) works
All reproduction and validation steps are documented

verification_steps.name: Root Cause Documentation
verification_steps.command: test -f test-projects/ROOT_CAUSE_WEB.md && test -f test-projects/ROOT_CAUSE_MOBILE.md && test -f test-projects/ROOT_CAUSE_PIPELINE.md

verification_steps.name: Validation Evidence
verification_steps.command: test -f test-projects/VALIDATION_WEB.md && test -f test-projects/VALIDATION_MOBILE.md && test -f test-projects/E2E_VALIDATION.md
verification_steps.expected_outcome: All validation documents exist and show success

verification_strategy.reasoning: Medium risk investigation workflow - requires manual validation of bootstrap flows across multiple stacks. No automated tests possible for investigation phase, but validation phase requires documented evidence of success.

checks: REPRODUCTION.md files contain complete output from each test
ROOT_CAUSE.md files identify specific failures with evidence
VALIDATION.md files show ARCHITECTURE.md was successfully generated
